test_dataframe_count: test the DataFrame.count() method returns a Series with non-null counts per column
test_dataframe_count_axis: test DataFrame.count(axis=0) counts non-null values per column and DataFrame.count(axis=1) counts per row
test_dataframe_count_empty: test DataFrame.count() on an empty DataFrame returns an empty Series with int64 dtype
test_dataframe_count_index_only: test DataFrame.count(axis=1) on a DataFrame with only an index returns a Series of zeros
test_dataframe_count_columns_only: test DataFrame.count(axis=0) on a DataFrame with only columns returns a Series of zeros
